correctness.rationale: After deleting the duplicate generator row, the nine columns have multiplicities 4,2,2,1 for types a=(1,1,1), b=(1,1,0), c=(0,1,1), d=(0,1,0). Any coordinate automorphism of a full-rank generator satisfies \(AH=HP\) for a unique \(A\in GL(3,2)\), so A preserves the column multiset. Multiplicities force a and d fixed and permit only fixing or interchanging b,c. Since b,c,d are a basis and a=b+c+d, these choices give exactly two row actions. Each supports \(4!2!2!=96\) coordinate bijections, yielding 192. The nontrivial action swaps the two size-two classes, giving \(S_4\times((S_2\times S_2)\rtimes S_2)\). A fresh independent enumeration of all 168 matrices in GL(3,2) found exactly these two multiset preservers; the frozen verifier independently exhausts all 9! coordinate permutations and the source-generated subgroup.

final_claim: For Kwiatkowski's binary Example 2 SR-sum \(D=C\oplus_{\mathrm{sr}}C\subseteq\mathbb F_2^9\), the full coordinate-permutation automorphism group is \(S_4\times(S_2\wr S_2)\) of order 192, with coordinate orbits \(\{1,2,4,5\}\), \(\{3,6,7,8\}\), and \(\{9\}\); the symmetries explicitly exhibited in the source generate the full group.
